description.en: The domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0) operation to obtain the domain name.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

description.zh:
主机记录。

如果要解析@.exmaple.com，主机记录要填写”@”，而不是空。
description.en:
The hostname field in the DNS record.

For example, if you want to resolve @.example.com, you must set this parameter to an at sign (@) instead of leaving it empty.

description.zh:
解析记录类型。如果不填写，则返回子域名对应的全部解析记录类型。

解析类型包括(不区分大小写)：**A、MX、CNAME、TXT、REDIRECT_URL、FORWORD_URL、NS、AAAA、SRV**。
description.en:
The type of DNS records. If you do not specify this parameter, all types of DNS records corresponding to the subdomain are returned.

Valid values: **A, MX, CNAME, TXT, REDIRECT_URL, FORWORD_URL, NS, AAAA, and SRV**. The value is not case-sensitive.
The IP address of the client.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns delete-sub-domain-records --lang en --user-client-ip 192.0.2.1 --domain-name example.com --rr www --type A --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DeleteSubDomainRecords --region cn-hangzhou --RR www --Type A --DomainName 'example.com' --UserClientIp '192.0.2.1' --Lang en
